question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Though this is undoutedly the greatest dictionary ever assembled, it is not designed for lexical analyser.
solution:
The correct answer is: **undoutedly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"undoutedly"** is misspelled and does not have a meaning in English. (गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Example: **There is no correct example for the misspelled word "undoutedly".
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"undoubtedly"** which means something that is certain or without doubt. (निस्संदेह)
 
 
• **Example: **He is undoubtedly the best player on the team.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **undoutedly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **designed **(डिज़ाइन किया): Planned and created for a specific purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** This software is designed to help students learn mathematics.
 
 
 
• **Though **(हालांकि): Despite the fact that; although.
 
 
• **Example: **Though it was raining, we decided to go for a walk.
 
 
 
• **dictionary** (शब्दकोश): A reference book containing words and their meanings.
 
 
• **Example:** I use the dictionary to look up the meanings of difficult words.
